Extension: iHRIS Page Display

Official URL: http://ihris.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/ihris-page-display Version: 0.1.0
Active as of 2026-10-10 Computable Name: IhrisPageDisplay

iHRIS Page Display details.

Context of Use

    This extension may be used on the following element(s)

    • Element ID: IhrisPage

Usage info

Usages:

  • Use this Extension: iHRIS Page
  • Examples for this Extension: Basic/ihris-page-auditevent, Basic/ihris-page-role, Basic/ihris-page-task, Basic/ihris-page-test-codesystem and Basic/ihris-page-test-practitioner
